_about: Single source of truth for Frostbite 9. Firmware, PCB, case and host script must all match this file. Units mm, PCB coordinates: origin at the PCB top-left (back-left corner as seen from above), x to the right, y toward the user (KiCad convention). 'Back' = y=0 edge, where the USB cable exits.
name: Frostbite

mcu.side: bottom (underside of the PCB), soldered by its castellated pads so no pins poke through under the OLED
mcu.usb: USB-C points to the back edge (y=0); XIAO board edge flush with the PCB edge so the receptacle overhangs ~1.4 mm

encoder.knob: 18 mm knob printed in black, 6 mm D-shaft
encoder.note: Footprint rotated 90 deg (shaft position unchanged) so the A/C/B pins sit at y 20.5, clear of J1.

oled.mount: Module soldered to J1 with the header's plastic spacer removed; it rests on the printed OLEDSupport, which sets its height (see case.oled_support)

case.style: all black flat sandwich: flat Top plate on a plain Bottom tray, no tilt and no gap. Top, Bottom, OLEDSupport and Knob printed in black. Four M3 screw heads show at the corners of the plate
case.inserts: 4 x M3 heat-set (OD 5, L 4, hole 4.7) in the Bottom corners, flush with the rim; M3x16 screws from the plate top through the Top into the inserts

usb_cutout.edge: back, centred on the XIAO receptacle

screws._about: Screw heads sit on the plate top. M3 heat-set inserts in the Bottom corners; each boss (OD 7.6 = hole 4.7 + 2 x 1.45 wall) is a circle of the tray corner, fully outside the PCB insertion envelope (PCB + tolerance) because the PCB drops into the Bottom from above. Axes are 3.0 outside the PCB corner in x and y, 4.0 from the outer skin, so the border is 7.0.

oled_support._about: Printed OLEDSupport part. The module's black header plastic is removed and the module rests on this part, so module_gap (module board underside above the PCB top) sets the stack: glass 0.55 below the plate top, 1.0 of air under the lip. Printed height = module_gap.

usb.note: test values; the host filters on them

protocol._about: Raw HID, 32-byte reports. Byte 0 = command. Unused bytes zero.

host_to_device.0x03 OLED_LINE: [0x03, line 0-1, len, up to 21 ASCII bytes]

protocol.fallback_without_host: If no PING for 5 s, keys send keycodes instead: agent1-6 = F13-F18, approve = F19, talk = F20 (held while held), stop = Escape; encoder = volume.
